meta.name: azure-storage
meta.description: Azure Storage Services including Blob Storage, File Shares, Queue Storage, Table Storage, and Data Lake. Answers questions about storage access tiers (hot, cool, cold, archive), when to use each tier, and tier comparison. Provides object storage, SMB file shares, async messaging, NoSQL key-value, and big data analytics. Includes lifecycle management. USE FOR: blob storage, file shares, queue storage, table storage, data lake, upload files, download blobs, storage accounts, access tiers, storage tiers, hot cool cold archive, storage tier comparison, when to use storage tiers, lifecycle management, Azure Storage concepts. DO NOT USE FOR: SQL databases, Cosmos DB (use azure-prepare), messaging with Event Hubs or Service Bus (use azure-messaging).

copy.tagline: 管理 Azure 存储服务，包括 Blob、文件、队列、表和 Data Lake
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Azure 上管理对象存储、文件共享或大数据分析
copy.tagline_en: Manage Azure storage services including Blob, Files, Queues, Tables, and Data Lake
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage object storage, file shares, or big data analytics on Azure

howto.what: Claude 可以回答关于 Azure 存储服务的问题，包括 Blob 存储、文件共享、队列存储、表存储和 Data Lake。它能解释访问层（热、冷、冷、归档）的用途和比较，以及生命周期管理。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Azure 存储概念、存储账户、访问层、上传/下载 blob 或文件共享时触发。

say.text: Azure Blob 存储的热访问层和冷访问层有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会解释各层的成本和使用场景。

say.text: 帮我列出我的存储账户中的容器。
say.note: Claude 会调用 MCP 工具列出容器。

say.text: 如何上传一个文件到 Blob 存储？
say.note: Claude 会提供 CLI 或 SDK 示例。

howto.what_en: Claude can answer questions about Azure Storage services including Blob, File Shares, Queue, Table, and Data Lake. It explains access tiers (hot, cool, cold, archive), their use cases, comparisons, and lifecycle management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about Azure Storage concepts, storage accounts, access tiers, uploading/downloading blobs, or file shares.

say_en.text: What is the difference between hot and cool access tiers in Azure Blob Storage?
say_en.note: Claude explains cost and usage for each tier.

say_en.text: List the containers in my storage account.
say_en.note: Claude uses MCP tool to list containers.

say_en.text: How do I upload a file to Blob Storage?
say_en.note: Claude provides CLI or SDK example.
